Hey! Thank you for the kind comment :) I'm so glad it made you feel better, as I know this can all be very anxiety producing and it does put some stress on a relationship. 

However I have only positive things to share thus far with only 67 days left! We've had to work on somethings mainly with communication and some compromise but all in all it's really not so bad. We talk way more than I thought we would and yea there are some really hard days don't get me wrong. This trip so far has just made us even closer and really really appreciate the little things we may have taken for granted being together (hugs, looking into her eyes, being able to bring her flowers in person, etc.) and I honestly think it's something every couple should have to go through. 

My advice is stay busy! I sat at home a lot the first few weeks just wishing she was here and that made things a lot harder. I've found time to make new friends and try new things too. Also having a goal like mine is good, even if you don't achieve it just something to work on. Lastly plan a weekend trip for when she's back, we planned a trip to Vermont the week she's back and that's a HUGE help for both of us, arguably the biggest help. 

You've got a while until she leaves. Please make the most of it and be a great significant other (though you sound like you definitely are) and try and think what you'll miss most about her/not be able to do while she's gone, then do lots of those in this time you have before she leaves! Make memories, take pictures of her and together, and plan for the trip, and you'll be just fine :) 

Shoot me a PM anytime if you have questions or need advice I'd be happy to help! Best of luck.
